observations.behavior: Adds Collection import, Subscription model import, and two new helper functions to products/exports/backend/facade/api.py.
observations.posthog_connection: These helpers support downstream cleanup of insights tied to dashboards or insights that have active subscriptions, without fetching full row data. P1.F2.H5 uses insight_ids_with_subscriptions and dashboard_ids_with_subscriptions to preserve insights that users have subscribed to, while P1.F2.H7 uses dashboard_ids_with_subscriptions to preserve dashboards with active subscriptions.

observations.behavior: Adds imports of the two subscription helpers and updates command help and argument descriptions.
observations.posthog_connection: These imports are required for P1.F2.H5 and P1.F2.H7, which use subscription and dashboard subscription checks to preserve insights and dashboards that are actively shared or subscribed to, rather than deleting them.

observations.behavior: Updates command help and argument descriptions to clarify that the command now also handles soft-deleted flags and orphaned insights, and that it preserves insights with active subscriptions or dashboards with active subscriptions.
